title: eichstelle adapter job, protocol version 1
description: What the harness writes to a file and hands an adapter the path to. Decision record 0006 in docs/decisions is where the contract is argued and docs/adapter-contract.md is how to satisfy it. Every physical quantity is a decimal string for the same reason as in a fixture: a JSON number is an IEEE 754 double in every parser this contract has to cross.

protocol_version.description: So an adapter written against an older contract refuses rather than guesses.

kind.description: A measurement, or a declaration of what this adapter claims. Both travel through the same job and result files, so an adapter author implements one contract and not two.

fixture_id.description: Copied from the fixture. Echoed in the result so an answer written to the wrong path is detected rather than misattributed.

signal_path.description: An absolute path to the generated stimulus. The file is read-only, it lives outside the working directory, and the same file is handed to every adapter in a run, so a disagreement is about the implementations and never about the bytes they were given.

sample_rate.description: In hertz, describing the file at signal_path.

edition.description: Which edition the answer is expected to be against. The result says which edition the adapter actually answered against, and the two are not always the same.

result_path.description: Where the adapter writes its result. An adapter writes here and nowhere else outside its working directory.

working_directory.description: A fresh directory the harness created for this invocation and will delete afterwards. It is the process working directory. An adapter may not write outside it.

timeout_seconds.description: The limit the harness will terminate at. It is in the job so an adapter that wants to give up early can, and so the number is not a secret the harness keeps to itself.

allOf.description: A measurement job carries a fixture, a signal and a metric. A capability job carries none of them, so requiring them unconditionally would refuse half the contract.
A capability job carries no fixture and no signal. Naming one would invite an adapter to answer about a stimulus that was never generated.
